card.text: A massive cluster that acts as a magnifying glass for galaxies far behind it.

sources.label: ESA/Hubble heic1615a: NASA, ESA, and J. Lotz (STScI)
sources.locator: caption: the huge mass of the cluster acts as a cosmic magnifying glass and enlarges even more distant galaxies

sources.locator: z = 0.35166: comoving distance 1,425 Mpc, lookback time 4.00 Gyr, age 9785 Myr

introduction.text: Hubble's Frontier Fields view of the cluster and the far galaxies it magnifies. The picture is flat and has no depth.

sources.label: ESA/Hubble heic1615a: NASA, ESA, and J. Lotz (STScI)
